scope.purpose: Bind the minimum causal and semantic contract for a successor architecture proposal without selecting downstream implementation, evidence, or inference bytes.

organism_boundary.THINK: The continuing child's waking thought, action, and public-outcome loop.
organism_boundary.DREAM: Disposable waking-context management only; it is neither evidence nor a persistent memory authority.
organism_boundary.SLEEP: Compilation of grounded child-authored lived experience into a personal LoRA under the fresh-from-birth contract.
organism_boundary.BIRTH_BOOTSTRAP: An optional one-time target-blind schooling intervention before parenting; it is neither personal memory nor a recurring cognitive organ.

personal_sleep_causal_contract.candidate_equation: C_s := W(B_z, Z0_s, E_le_s, K_sleep, seed_s)

symbols.B_z: Immutable assigned birth artifact for birth arm z.
symbols.Z0_s: New personal LoRA whose effective delta is exactly zero before the first update of SLEEP event s.
symbols.E_le_s: Full cumulative eligible child-life corpus committed at or before the frozen cutoff for SLEEP event s.
symbols.K_sleep: Frozen personal-writer, replay, and dose contract bound before the event.
symbols.seed_s: The event's bound candidate-construction randomness identity.
symbols.eq_s: Equality-only guard for staging and the intended life/head transaction; it conveys no model content and cannot condition C_s.
symbols.W: The sole personal response-only candidate-writing transformation.
symbols.C_s: Closed personal candidate bytes produced for preservation evaluation; they are not active merely because they exist.
symbols.S_s: The transactionally staged reference to C_s after the equality-only guard passes.

cumulative_corpus.cutoff: A frozen committed-life cutoff established before candidate construction begins.
cumulative_corpus.membership: Every and only eligible child-life proposition record at or before the cutoff.
cumulative_corpus.coverage: Every eligible proposition record in the cumulative corpus receives at least one loss-bearing inclusion under K_sleep; selection may choose admissible renderings but may not silently omit an eligible proposition.
cumulative_corpus.history_on_candidate_rejection: Committed child life and its eligibility records remain; candidate artifacts and derivatives do not become corpus evidence.

prior_active_weight_role.historical_path_allowed: Earlier active weights may already have causally affected committed waking thoughts and actions; once those events independently satisfy eligibility, their committed records may appear in E_le_s.
prior_active_weight_role.semantic_rule: The historical waking path does not license direct or derived prior-weight access by W.

mutation_invariance.intervention: Arbitrarily mutate or substitute the prior active-weight artifact after E_le_s is frozen.
mutation_invariance.required_execution_relation: The writer's attempted reads, branches, sample choices, dose, gradients, and candidate serialization are identical.
mutation_invariance.promotion_caveat: Changing the actual active head may independently make staging or the later equality-bound promotion transaction stale; that permitted guard consequence occurs after C_s closes and must not alter C_s.

activation.promotion_requirement: A separately valid preservation verdict and equality-bound full-head transaction are required.
activation.rejection_effect: Prior active weights and committed life remain active and intact; rejected candidate derivatives are quarantined.

clause_admissibility_contract.unit: Each semantic clause in every loss-bearing response or action target.
clause_admissibility_contract.decision_rule: A clause is admissible if and only if all authorship, temporal-precedence, grounding, semantic-identity, and provenance conditions below pass; dispute or missing evidence rejects the clause.

required_provenance.child_proposition_ids: One or more exact IDs resolving to committed propositions authored by this child in this life.
required_provenance.public_support_ids: One or more exact IDs resolving to the child's public action and/or public outcome evidence used by the declared grounding rule.
required_provenance.life_id: One exact life identity shared by the child proposition and support records.
required_provenance.commit_roots: Immutable roots proving that proposition and support records existed before eligibility and compilation.
required_provenance.grounding_rule_id: A prospectively frozen rule identifying why the cited public evidence supports the authored proposition.
required_provenance.evidence_threshold_id: The prospectively frozen evidence threshold, including any threshold required for a child-authored generalization.

child_authorship.required_event: The child emitted the proposition into a committed waking trace before the compiler first accessed it.
child_authorship.semantic_requirement: The complete asserted proposition, including predicate, arguments, relations, quantifiers, scope, polarity, modality, causal or temporal force, confidence, and generality, was already expressed by the child.
insufficient_conditions: The proposition is entailed or suggested by grounded premises but was never stated by the child.
The proposition appears only in parent, repetition-control, DREAM, compiler, evaluator, audit, or scientific text.
The child copied or repeated words without a separately qualifying grounded child proposition record.
A favorable outcome occurred after an unsupported thought or rationale.
A compiler-generated paraphrase is treated as the original authorship event.

temporal_precedence.prospective_claim_order: For a clause claiming a prior prediction, intention, rationale, or policy, child_authorship_commit < referenced_action_or_outcome.
temporal_precedence.retrospective_or_corrective_order: For a clause explicitly reporting a correction or reflection, referenced_action_or_outcome < child_authorship_commit < compiler_render; it may not be rendered as if authored prospectively.
temporal_precedence.relation_authorship: Chronology alone cannot create a causal, temporal, comparative, or confidence relation; any such relation in a loss-bearing clause must itself satisfy child authorship.

grounding.source_boundary: Only the same child's committed public actions and public outcomes may provide life grounding.
grounding.outcome_valence_rule: Success may support an already-authored grounded proposition, and rational failure or a child-authored correction may also qualify under their declared rules; outcome favorability alone neither creates nor validates a proposition.

corrective_clause.eligible_only_if: The child authored the corrected proposition after the cited corrective public evidence and before compilation, and the proposition independently meets the grounding rule.

generalized_clause.eligible_only_if: The child previously authored that generalized proposition at the same semantic scope and its declared evidence threshold was already satisfied before compilation.

compiler_semantic_boundary.role: Render eligible child-authored propositions into response-only replay, retrieval, and use views without adding cognition.

allowed_operations.contract: Choose only clause-admissible proposition IDs and support IDs; preserve full cumulative coverage under the writer contract.
Split an already-authored proposition into clauses only when their conjunction is semantically equivalent to the source and every clause retains provenance.
Reorder admissible clauses without changing asserted chronology, causality, scope, priority, or confidence.
Collapse semantically equivalent duplicates while retaining the union of provenance IDs and honoring the frozen exposure rule.
Repeat admissible clauses or views only according to the frozen replay and dose rule; every replay retains identical semantic provenance.

Place two independently admissible, already child-authored propositions beside each other. The compiler may add no loss-bearing comparison, synthesis, preference, causal link, or conclusion unless that exact relation was separately child-authored and grounded.
Render a meaning-preserving expression that is bidirectionally semantically equivalent to the child-authored source under the frozen audit; provenance and all semantic dimensions remain unchanged.
Create a cue/view whose loss-bearing response clauses are only admissible paraphrases or replays of cited child-authored propositions.
Create an application-form view only when every loss-bearing response or action clause is already child-authored and grounded at the represented scope; the view cannot solve a new case for the child.

audit_requirement.direction_1: Every rendered loss-bearing clause is entailed by its cited child-authored proposition without added semantic content.
audit_requirement.direction_2: The cited child-authored proposition is recoverable from the rendered clause without lost semantic qualifications relevant to the target.

parent_repetition_boundary.allowed_causal_path: parent_or_repetition_intervention -> current_waking_context -> child_thought -> child_action -> public_outcome -> committed_child_trace -> independent_clause_eligibility -> later_personal_SLEEP
parent_repetition_boundary.transitive_firewall: Bytes, semantics, IDs, counts, hashes, order, timing, cache state, filenames, and success or error shapes derived from parent or repetition control are forbidden inputs to support resolution, personal compilation, and candidate writing.
parent_repetition_boundary.child_restatement_rule: Parenting may causally change waking behavior. A later child proposition may enter SLEEP only through its own committed child-authorship, temporal-precedence, and grounding records; lexical novelty from the parent is not required, but parent provenance cannot substitute for child provenance or public grounding.

adaptive_parent.role: Separately labeled ecological policy allowed to use only prospectively permitted public child history.

parent_repetition_boundary.repetition_claim_limit: Neither uptake nor Delta_F identifies the causal benefit of repetition itself without a separate randomized one-exposure-versus-spaced-repetition factor.

birth_parent_factorial.core_design: primary_mechanism_factorial := birth_{D,T} x parent_{absent,fixed}; M0 is outside this factorial as a separate damage and prior-competence diagnostic

primary_birth_levels.meaning: Direct-solution active-control birth trained on the canonical rational action without the declared feedback-to-action computation.
Teachability birth trained to derive the same canonical rational action through exactly one declared general feedback-to-action computation.

M0_diagnostic.meaning: Unmodified frozen base model used only as a separate diagnostic for pre-existing competence and bootstrap damage.

parent_levels.meaning: Solo control with no parent process advice and prospectively matched nonparent opportunity.
The same exogenous parent-message schedule and bytes regardless of child history.

paired_T_D_contract.only_intended_difference: T's response demonstrates one declared feedback-to-action computation before the canonical action; D receives the same action directly.

target_blindness.meaning: Bootstrap construction has no incremental dependency on downstream developmental or evaluation targets beyond knowledge already present in frozen upstream models or demonstrators.

shared_outcome_contract.Y: Binary engine-recorded task success within the prospectively frozen budget; invalid, missing, or noncrossing observations are zero under the frozen rule.
shared_outcome_contract.evaluation_context: Every downstream exam begins from empty active context, uses a fresh executor, closes its transcript before model-free truth scoring, and has no return edge to the continuing child.

Delta_R.time: Immediately after immutable birth and before any personal SLEEP.
Delta_R.design: Independently assigned disposable same-state clones receive correct, none, irrelevant, or wrong novel process advice.
Delta_R.primary_comparison: The T-versus-D difference in the correct-versus-none advice effect.

control_roles.irrelevant: Tests selective rejection of nonuseful process advice.
control_roles.wrong: Tests selective rejection and safety under harmful process advice.
control_roles.M0: Diagnoses base competence or damage but is not substituted for D in Delta_R.

Delta_R.claim_if_supported: Immediate incremental selective receptivity conferred by T relative to the direct-solution control D.

Delta_F.time: Across the entry-normalized 32-lesson learning curve, not only the terminal lesson.
Delta_F.personal_SLEEP: Active under the fresh-from-birth full-cumulative-corpus contract in every relevant arm.
Delta_F.fixed_parent: Exogenous identical reminder bytes at child ages 1, 9, 17, and 25, with no history-conditioned timing or content.
Delta_F.claim_if_supported: T modifies the learning-speed effect of the total fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP regime relative to D.

Delta_E.design: A separately randomized and separately reported T/D by adaptive-parent/absent experiment using a prospectively frozen adaptive policy and matched nonparent opportunity.
Delta_E.personal_SLEEP: Active under the fresh-from-birth full-cumulative-corpus contract in every relevant arm.
Delta_E.claim_if_supported: T modifies the total practical adaptive-parent-plus-child-plus-personal-SLEEP package effect relative to D.

canary_spend_margins.meaning: Prospective feasibility and spend gates only; crossing them is neither a powered result nor sufficient claim evidence.

replication_floor.meaning: A minimum replication condition, not automatic statistical power, multiplicity control, or claim sufficiency.

deferred_exact_contracts.rule: These bytes must be frozen prospectively under separate exact human scope before their first relevant generation, implementation, execution, or claim; this core does not select them.
